_meta.indication: TRUQAP in combination with fulvestrant is indicated for adult patients with HR-positive, HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer with one or more PIK3CA/AKT1/PTEN-alterations as detected by an FDA-approved test following progression on at least one endocrine-based regimen in the metastatic setting.

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized (1:1), double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicenter trial of capivasertib + fulvestrant versus placebo + fulvestrant.
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with HR-positive, HER2-negative advanced or metastatic breast cancer who progressed on an aromatase inhibitor-based treatment; the label indication is limited to the PIK3CA/AKT1/PTEN-altered population (N=289).
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint: progression-free survival (PFS) by investigator assessment, prespecified in the overall population and the PIK3CA/AKT1/PTEN-altered population.
pivotal_trials.n: N=708 overall (355 capivasertib + fulvestrant, 353 placebo + fulvestrant); PIK3CA/AKT1/PTEN-altered population N=289 (155 and 134).
pivotal_trials.result: In the PIK3CA/AKT1/PTEN-altered population, median PFS was 7.3 months (95% CI: 5.5, 9.0) with capivasertib vs 3.1 months (95% CI: 2.0, 3.7) with placebo (HR 0.50 [95% CI: 0.38, 0.65]; p<0.0001). In the overall population, median PFS was 7.2 vs 3.6 months (HR 0.60 [95% CI: 0.51, 0.71]; p<0.001).

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (incidence >=20%, including lab abnormalities) were diarrhea, cutaneous adverse reactions, increased random glucose, decreased lymphocytes, decreased hemoglobin, increased fasting glucose, nausea, fatigue and others. Diarrhea occurred in 72% (Grade 3/4 in 9%); cutaneous adverse reactions in 58% (Grade 3/4 in 17%); hyperglycemia in 18% (Grade 3/4 in 2.8%).
target_moa: Capivasertib is an oral small-molecule kinase inhibitor of all 3 isoforms of the serine/threonine kinase AKT (AKT1, AKT2, AKT3), a node in the PI3K/AKT signaling pathway regulating survival, proliferation and metabolism.
companion_dx_detail: FoundationOne CDx (F1CDx) next-generation sequencing assay, approved as a companion diagnostic to select patients with PIK3CA/AKT1/PTEN alterations for capivasertib plus fulvestrant.

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee was convened; the application was not referred because there were no controversial issues and outside expertise was not necessary.

basis.text: The NDA was reviewed under Priority Review (PDUFA goal date November 29, 2023).

summary.text: TRUQAP received regular (full) approval under Priority Review, reviewed under Project Orbis, based on the randomized Phase III CAPItello-291 trial demonstrating a statistically significant PFS improvement; a FoundationOne CDx companion diagnostic was contemporaneously approved.

requirement.text: 4548-3 Conduct a hepatic impairment clinical trial to evaluate the pharmacokinetics and safety of capivasertib in patients with moderate hepatic impairment to assess for potential increase in capivasertib exposure and serious risk of increased adverse reactions. requirement.text: 4548-4 Conduct a clinical drug interaction study to evaluate the effect of repeat doses of capivasertib on the pharmacokinetics and safety of transporter substrates of BCRP, OATP1B1 and OATP1B3, to assess for potential serious risk associated with the magnitude of exposure change and inform appropriate drug interaction management strategy for coadministration of capivasertib with these transporter substrates. This trial should be designed and conducted in accordance with the FDA Guidance for Industry entitled "Clinical Drug Interaction Studies – Cytochrome P450 Enzyme- and Transporter-Mediated Drug Interactions."
